Every moby class the class tables of the boot module and the 19 level overlays list (overlay section 3: class, update function, hook table): the class id, our name (the update's port), the images whose table lists it, the instances the levels place (the development repository's census, `scan --census`), the update function per build with its port, the class hooks (the class row's hook table, six words: how many, whether ported, and the class's own ones by address; the shared default hooks 0x2db848 .. 0x2db888 not listed) and the oracle batches naming the update. `no code`: the row holds no function (the Hologuise rows, among others). A class a level lists but never places still counts as listed: the placement column tells them apart. `How`: how the update is ported (`hand`, `generated`, `both`; a slash when its builds differ), as in the function pages.
